title: Resin/HM20 Embedding and fMOST Imaging Protocol
author: Hui Gong

steps_raw.instruction: Protocol for Resin/ HM20 embedding and fMOST imaging
Author：Hui Gong, Xiangning Li, Can Zhou
Huazhong University of Science and Technology（HUST）
Part of the NIH BRAIN Initiative Cell Census Network (BICCN)
Award: U19MH114830 (Zeng) RS2
Principal Investigators – Qingming Luo and Hui Gong
List of reagents required for the experiment
Lowicryl HM20® resin filtration
Add Al2O3 powder to a clean glass column
Slowly pour the monomer E solution or cross-linker D of Lowicryl HM20® resin into the glass column and slowly introduce nitrogen
The filtered monomer E solution and cross-linker D are sealed in a brown bottle and stored at room temperature
Biological tissue rinsing
Prepare 0.01M PBS buffer solution and pre-cool the solution at 4 ° C environment
Put the mouse brain into a 50 ml centrifuge tube
Rinse the mouse brain with pre-cooled PBS solution 3 times for 2h, 2h and 12h. The rinsing process should be carried out at 4 ° C in the dark
Biological tissue dehydration
Prepare 50, 75, and 95% (vol/vol) graded ethanol solutions in distilled water. For example, for 50% ethanol solutions, add 1 volume absolute ethanol to 1 volume distilled water in a centrifuge tube
The mouse brain is placed in a 50 ml centrifuge tube and dehydrated with 50% ethanol solution for 1 hour
The mouse brain is dehydrated for every 2 hours in 75% and 95% ethanol solution
The mouse brain is dehydrated in absolute ethanol 3 times for 2 hours each time, and all dehydration steps were carried out at 4 ° C in the dark
Biological tissue resin penetration
Placed 0.048g of AIBN crystal particles, 5.25g crosslink D and 24.75g monomer E solution in a 60ml brown glass bottle
Slowly stir the mixed solution on a magnetic stirrer for about 5-10 minutes until the AIBN crystal particles are completely dissolved to form resin working solution and stored it at 4 ° C in the dark

Prepare 50% and 75% (wt/wt) graded resin solutions in absolute ethanol. For example, for 50% resin solutions, add 1 weight absolute ethanol to 1 weight resin working solution in a brown glass bottle, and stored at 4 ° C
Dispense the prepared resin working solution into 3 brown glass bottles, 5 g each, and store at 4 °C
The dehydrated mouse brain is pre-permeated for 2 hours in 50% and 75% graded resin solution respectively at 4 ° C in the dark
The pre-permeated mouse brain was transferred to the 3 brown glass bottles with resin working solution for 2 h, 24 h at 4 ° C in the dark
Biological tissue acid quenching
Pipette 5 g resin working solution into a brown glass bottle, add acetic acid to generate the CR-quench solution, and store it at 4 °C in the dark
The infiltrated mouse brain was transferred to a CR-quench solution and stored at 4 ° C for 14 h in the dark
Biological tissue resin polymerization
Place the opened 000# capsule on the capsule hole of the sample holder

The mouse brain olfactory bulb is facing downward, and the ventral side is slightly tilted into the gelatin capsule to ensure that the olfactory bulb is in the center of the capsule bottom, and the brain is nearly perpendicular to the capsule bottom
Add about 1 ml resin to the capsule and place it in a vacuum drying oven
Adjust the oven temperature to 37 ° C for 20 hours
Finally adjust the oven temperature to 50 °C for 4 hours, the sample polymerization is completed
Turn off the oven, open the intake valve, open the oven door and take out the sample.
Fix the sample with the sample holder and install the sample holder in the sample cell.
Align the diamond knife in BioMapping 5000* with the sample.
Prepare 0.05mol/L sodium carbonate with 1 ug/ml propidium iodide in PBS as the immersion solution during imaging.
Add the immersion solution into sample cell to completely immerse the sample.
Cut the sample surface into flat.
Run the data acquisition program in BioMapping 5000 with the appointed parameters.
Upload the data after the data acquisition.
*BioMapping 5000, a type of fluorescence Micro-Optical Sectioning Tomography Instrument（fMOST）
